Date: May 22–31, 2026
* 🔴 User financial profile & goals: Emergency fund target is $24,000; aims to increase monthly savings by $300; holds only 401(k) index funds (never owned individual stocks).
* ✅ Completed financial analyses & actions (May):
  * Analyzed mortgage refinance (3.1% rate, saves $85/mo) and summarized 2026 charitable donations/medical deductions.
  * Configured automatic $250/payday high-yield savings and $250 money market transfers.
  * Established $180/month Roth IRA contribution (projected $420 annual tax savings).
  * Optimized debt allocations for student loans and credit cards.

Date: Jun 4–8, 2026
* 🔴 User requested low-fee index fund recommendations for diversification beyond current 401(k) holdings.
* 🔴 (19:10 Jun 8) User stated tax filing extension deadline is June 18, 2026.
* ✅ Completed June financial planning:
  * Allocated $200 utility rebate to credit card debt (projected $950 interest savings).
  * Researched Solo 401(k) options for $4,200 quarterly bonus.
  * Established $150/month Costa Rica vacation savings fund.
  * Reviewed HSA contribution limits ($3,850 family cap for 2026).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Providing low-fee index fund recommendations for portfolio diversification.
- Secondary: Preparing for upcoming tax filing extension deadline on June 18, 2026.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
- "I can help you select low-fee index funds to diversify beyond your 401(k). Would you like to look at total market, international, or specific sector funds?"
